english.title: Enter / get onto / tamper with a vehicle / truck / trolley / aircraft steps / brakes - Stansted Airport

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 7(3) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
